name: 38668 · Senatobia, MS
findings: ZIP 38668 (Senatobia) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 38668 (Senatobia) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
43% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
